snippet.title: Pilot’s Briefing Launch Trailer: Iron Rebellion VR Mech Game | Black Beach Studio
snippet.description:
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192900/IRON_REBELLION/?utm_source=LaunchTrailer
Buy on Meta: https://vr.meta.me/s/1KAP0CDDGlxHKsH

Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/aa7j5FE5zv

Iron Rebellion is a VR mech simulator featuring fully interactive cockpits, tactical multiplayer combat, and customizable war machines.
Available now only on VR through Meta and Steam.
